1	import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/rate-limiter'
3	
4	describe('RateLimiter (fixed mode)', () => {
5	  beforeEach(() => {
6	    vi.useFakeTimers()
7	    vi.setSystemTime(0)
8	  })
9	
10	  afterEach(() => {
11	    vi.useRealTimers()
12	  })
13	
14	  it('allows the first request', () => {
15	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
16	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
17	  })
18	
19	  it('allows up to max requests, then denies', () => {
20	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 3, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
21	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
22	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
23	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
24	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
25	  })
26	
27	  it('resets capacity at the start of the next window', () => {
28	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
29	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
30	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
31	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
32	    vi.setSystemTime(1000)
33	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
34	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
35	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
36	  })
37	
38	  it('tracks separate counts per key', () => {
39	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
40	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
41	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
42	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
43	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
44	  })
45	})
46	
47	describe('RateLimiter (sliding mode)', () => {
48	  beforeEach(() => {
49	    vi.useFakeTimers()
50	    vi.setSystemTime(0)
51	  })
52	
53	  afterEach(() => {
54	    vi.useRealTimers()
55	  })
56	
57	  it('allows up to max requests in the trailing window, then denies', () => {
58	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
59	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
60	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
61	    }
62	    vi.setSystemTime(500)
63	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
64	  })
65	
66	  it('denies after a fixed-window boundary if old requests are still in the trailing window', () => {
67	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
68	    vi.setSystemTime(500)
69	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
70	    vi.setSystemTime(999)
71	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
72	    vi.setSystemTime(1000)
73	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
74	  })
75	
76	  it('admits a new request once the oldest one ages out', () => {
77	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
78	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
79	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
80	    }
81	    vi.setSystemTime(500)
82	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
83	    vi.setSystemTime(1100)
84	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
85	  })
86	
87	  it('tracks keys independently in sliding mode', () => {
88	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
89	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
90	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
91	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
92	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(false)
93	  })
94	})
